About Aegis Ventures 

 Aegis Ventures partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. Our platform brings together market-shaping ideas, growth capital, and ambitious individuals to solve major societal problems. With a focus on innovations in healthcare, Aegis has launched four successful portfolio companies in partnership with Northwell Health and recently announced the Digital Consortium to co-develop, invest in, and launch new companies.

 About the Company 

 Avandra Imaging 's mission is to unlock clinical data to overcome previously impossible medical challenges, bringing hope and medical breakthroughs that transform patient lives. Avandra is poised to revolutionize healthcare research and innovation by creating the largest indexed data cloud of medical imaging. This platform will unlock unprecedented access to real-world imaging data, essential for biopharma research, medical device innovation, AI model training, and improved patient care. 

 Leveraging its strategic acquisitions, Avandra aims to aggregate and de-identify vast amounts of imaging data, providing frictionless access to this invaluable resource. With a national footprint of over 5,000 customer integrations and a market share of approximately 70%, this robust infrastructure supports their core business, ensuring continued growth and cash flow to fuel their innovative data cloud platform.

 About the Job 

 As our Product Manager , you will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Avandra’s image exchange platform. This role is responsible for  evolving our industry-leading physical media solutions while bringing a new generation of digital  image exchange products to market. 

 This is a unique opportunity to build products that sit at the intersection of enterprise imaging and  real-world imaging data. The platform you build will not only help providers securely exchange  medical images, but also create new opportunities for health systems to participate in Avandra’s  imaging data network. 

 The ideal candidate has deep experience in enterprise imaging, understands clinical imaging  workflows, and has successfully brought healthcare software products from concept through  commercial launch.

 What You’ll Do 

 Product Strategy  

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for Avandra’s Enterprise Imaging portfolio.

• Define and prioritize initiatives that expand our digital image exchange capabilities while continuing to strengthen our physical media solutions. 

• Develop products that simplify how imaging moves between providers, patients, and  healthcare organizations. 

• Identify market opportunities and customer needs that differentiate Avandra in a rapidly  evolving imaging ecosystem. 

 Product Development  

• Lead products from concept through launch, working closely with engineering, design,  sales, customer success, and executive leadership. 

• Write clear product requirements and user stories that translate customer problems into actionable engineering work. 

• Balance customer requests, technical constraints, and business priorities when making roadmap decisions. 

• Partner with engineering throughout development to ensure successful delivery and product quality. 

 Customer & Market Engagement  

• Meet regularly with health systems, imaging centers, and strategic partners to understand  workflows and emerging market needs. 

• Gather customer feedback through interviews, product demonstrations, and beta programs. 

• Monitor competitive offerings and industry trends across enterprise imaging and healthcare interoperability. 

• Represent Avandra at customer meetings and industry conferences. 

 Data Network Innovation  

• Develop capabilities that make it easier for healthcare organizations to participate in Avandra’s imaging data network. 

• Work cross-functionally to ensure image exchange products create long-term strategic value across both clinical and data-driven use cases. 

• Partner with internal stakeholders to identify new platform capabilities that benefit providers, researchers, and life sciences organizations. 

 Product Launch  

• Partner with marketing and sales to develop product positioning, messaging, pricing support, and go-to-market plans. 

• Support customer enablement, product documentation, training, and launch readiness.

• Define success metrics and continuously measure product adoption and customer satisfaction. 

 What You’ll Need 

 Required 

• 5+ years of product management experience. 

• Experience building enterprise healthcare software products. 

• Strong understanding of enterprise imaging workflows, including PACS, VNA, DICOM, and  image exchange. 

• Experience leading products from concept through commercial launch. • Ability to translate complex customer workflows into intuitive software solutions. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile development environments. 

• Bachelor’s degree.

 Preferred  

• Experience with healthcare interoperability technologies including DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.

• Experience in cloud-based SaaS healthcare platforms. 

• Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, and compliance requirements.

• Experience working directly with radiology departments, imaging centers, or health  systems. 

 What Success Looks Like in Year One 

• Successfully launch new digital image exchange capabilities that expand Avandra’s product portfolio. 

• Deliver a clear and executable product roadmap that aligns customer needs with company strategy. 

• Increase adoption of Avandra’s image sharing platform across existing and new customers.

• Improve the customer experience across both physical and digital image exchange workflows.

• Deliver platform capabilities that strengthen Avandra’s position as the trusted infrastructure for imaging exchange and imaging data. 

 What We Offer 

• Meaningful Impact: The work we do directly enables medical breakthroughs — such as earlier cancer detection, better Alzheimer's treatments, AI diagnostics that save lives. This isn't abstract; it's the reason our health system partners invest in us.

• Career-Defining Opportunity: You'll have a front-row seat to every aspect of building a category-defining company—strategy, operations, fundraising, M&A, scaling.

• Exceptional Team: Work alongside a founder with a track record of building and exiting healthcare technology companies, backed by investors who are true partners.

• Competitive Package: Competitive salary, equity, comprehensive benefits, and hybrid work flexibility.

• Values-Driven Culture: We’re building a team grounded in Avandra’s 5 Core Values that guide how we show up every day:

• WIN with Integrity

• Radical Accountability

• Engage with Empathy

• Innovation Through Playful Curiosity

• Patients First
